name: Indian Egg, Tomato & Spinach Curry with Toasted Naan Bread
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.

Add marinara, water, spices, and sugar to the pot. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve eggs and place in a small bowl; set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the curry has thickened, add spinach and cilantro to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add eggs to the curry, gently stir to combine, and continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, toast naan if desired, then cut into wedges.
Divide curry between bowls and serve with naan on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
